spans.s:
The affix घञ् comes after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with अव and नि when maledicition is meant.

Terms: घञ्

The affix अनि comes after a verb when the particle नञ् is in composition with it and the sense implied is that of 'cursing'.

Terms: अनि

The affixes ठञ् and ठक् come after the word आक्रन्द being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'who runs'.

Terms: ठञ् and ठक्

A word formed by the कृत् affixes अच् and क preceded by a Negative Particle have an acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when one abuses somebody by that word.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term
